title: App Retargeting & Re-engagement
deck: Retargeting drives existing users back and revives dormant ones. The keys are (1) precise audience segmentation, (2) deferred deep links landing users on the exact screen, (3) personalized copy.
summary: Run user acquisition (UA) and retargeting (RT) as separate campaigns. RT builds Lookalikes from LTV-validated high-value seeds and reaches 7–30-day dormant users with personalized messaging. Every RT ad click must route through a deferred deep link straight to the last screen the user saw.

rows: New items in recently viewed categories

content.html: Retargeting ad click → users without the app go via the store, then route to the original ad URL on first launch. Uses the DeeplinkRouter from guide 1-1.

items: Primary seed: VIP purchasers — purchase 3+ or top-10% LTV. Build the network Lookalike at 1%.
Secondary seed: high engagement — D7 retention held + 5+ sessions/day. Use when the primary seed is too small.
Forbidden seeds: plain installers or signup-only users — you get a Lookalike that only resembles "people likely to click ads", with cheap CPI but below-average LTV.

content.title: Retargeting and UA hit the same users and cannibalize
content.html: Always add a Customer List (installers) exclusion to UA campaigns. Meta: Audience Suppression option; Google: handle via the campaign's Negative Audience.

content.title: Deferred deep link doesn't fire on first launch
content.html: See guide 1-1 §4. Android depends on the Install Referrer API; iOS requires LinkMe or Universal Link domain verification.

content.title: Customer List match rate is low (under 40% on Meta)
content.html: Normalization was skipped before hashing emails/phone numbers. Lowercase, strip whitespace, unify country codes (+82 etc.), then SHA-256. Meta accepts only hashes, never raw values.
